_note: Tickets with a known root cause, created live with: node demo/new-ticket.mjs --scenario <name>. 'expected' is the answer key used to score the agent (docs/AGENT_TRAINING.md). It lives outside the MediAgenda repository on purpose: the agent never sees it.

expected.cause: clearing the Struttura field by hand does not remove the structure from AgendaSearchStore.selectedStructureIds, so the next search sends two structureIds
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2398 (store appends every selected structure); CUP_DEMO-2511 fixed only the PULISCI button

birth-date.summary: [FE] - Pazienti: the birth date is saved one day earlier
birth-date.description:
In Anagrafica paziente I type the birth date 14/06/1991 and press SALVA. When I open the patient again the date is 13/06/1991.
Every time the same patient is saved, the date moves back one more day. It happens on every operator PC in Milano and Lodi.

How to reproduce:
1 - Pazienti > NUOVO PAZIENTE
2 - fill in the fields, Data di nascita 14/06/1991
3 - SALVA, then open the patient (Modifica): Data di nascita shows 13/06/1991

expected.cause: toIsoDate() uses Date.toISOString(), i.e. UTC: local midnight in Italy (UTC+1/+2) is the previous day in UTC
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2612 (Sara Colombo, 2026-10-20): birth date typed as dd/MM/yyyy
expected.fix: build the ISO string from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate (local), not from toISOString()

cancelled-slot.summary: [BE] - Prenotazioni: a cancelled appointment is never offered again
cancelled-slot.description:
PR-2026-00590 (Costa Andrea, CARDIOLOGIA CASALE, 17/11 at 14:10) was cancelled on 2 November at the patient's request.
In Nuova prenotazione, for CA_CARDIOLOGIA on 17/11 the 14:10 appointment is still missing; all the other times are there.
In September cancelled times were offered again (we tested it then).

expected.cause: BookingRepository.findBookedTimes() does not filter out ANNULLATA bookings, so a cancelled time still counts as booked
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2620 (Luca Bianchi, 2026-10-22): one query for the booked times; regression of CUP_DEMO-2533 (Marta asked about it in the review)
expected.fix: add "and b.status <> 'ANNULLATA'" to findBookedTimes (or pass the status), plus a test: cancel → time offered again

annullate-filter.summary: [FE] - Prenotazioni: the Annullate filter shows no bookings
annullate-filter.description:
In Prenotazioni, with Stato = Annullate the table says "Nessuna prenotazione", but PR-2026-00590 is cancelled: it is shown as ANNULLATA with Stato = Tutte.
Confermate and Completate work.

expected.cause: the option value of Annullate is 'ANNULLATE', but the status is 'ANNULLATA': GET /api/bookings?status=ANNULLATE returns nothing
expected.fix: option value="ANNULLATA" (better: options built from the BookingStatus type)
